en: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples mutter vanity?

he: יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ ׀ מַלְכֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ־יָ֑חַד עַל־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃
en: The kings of the earth stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Havayah and against His anointed:
Let us break their bands asunder, and cast their cords from us.
He Who dwells in heaven laughs; Adonai mocks them.

he: אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃
en: Then He shall speak to them in His anger, and terrify them in His burning wrath:
But I have anointed My king upon Tzion, My holy mountain.

he: אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל־חֹ֥ק יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר־אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ׃
en: I will tell of the decree: Havayah said to me: You are My son; I this day have begotten you.

he: שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
en: Ask of Me, and I will give nations as your inheritance, and the ends of the earth as your possession.

he: תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃
en: You shall break them with a rod of iron; as a potter's vessel you shall dash them in pieces.

he: וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
en: And now, O kings, be wise; be instructed, O judges of the earth.
Serve Havayah with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

he: נַשְּׁקוּ־בַ֡ר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַ֤ף ׀ וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי־יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כׇּל־ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃ {פ}
en: Kiss the son, lest He be angry, and you perish on the way — for His anger burns but a little. Happy are all who take refuge in Him. (End of the passage.)
